name: shipkit
description: The ShipKit skill system as an installable plugin: ui-system, component-picker, asset-pipeline, convex-structure, frontend-security, seo-blog, testing, setup-health, production-preflight and upstream-sync. Deterministic UI rules (tokens, curated fonts, no AI-generated look), a verified backend structure for Convex + Better Auth + Stripe + Resend, and health/heal/preflight gates. Pairs with the ShipKit engine repo, which the same repository ships: scaffold from github.com/moasq/shipkit, or install this plugin to bring the rules into an existing session.
